name: Blade Ward
description: You trace a protective sigil that causes attackers to take a penalty on their attack rolls against you while you concentrate.

name: Booming Blade
components: V, M (a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp)
description: You channel thunderous energy into a melee weapon and strike a creature. If the target then moves away before your next turn, it takes extra thunder damage.

name: Control Flames
description: You magically manipulate an existing nonmagical flame within range, expanding, extinguishing, or shaping it, or producing simple shapes and colors of fire.

name: Create Bonfire
description: You conjure a magical bonfire in a 5-foot cube. Creatures that enter or start their turn in the fire take fire damage, and it can ignite flammables.

name: Friends
description: You magically enhance your charisma toward one creature, granting advantage on Charisma checks against it, but the target becomes hostile when the effect ends.

name: Frostbite
description: You cause numbing frost to form on a creature you can see. It must succeed on a Constitution save or take cold damage and have disadvantage on its next weapon attack roll.

name: Green-Flame Blade
components: S, M (a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp)
description: You brandish a melee weapon and strike a creature, dealing normal damage plus fire. Green fire then leaps to a second nearby creature, dealing fire damage based on your level.

name: Gust
description: You create a brief blast of wind that can push a creature, move a light object, or extinguish unprotected flames.

name: Infestation
description: You cause a cloud of mites, fleas, or other parasites to swarm a creature. It takes poison damage and must move in a random direction on a failed save.

name: Lightning Lure
description: You create a lash of lightning that pulls a creature toward you and deals lightning damage if it fails a Strength save.

name: Magic Stone
description: You touch up to three pebbles and imbue them with magic. You or a companion can make a ranged spell attack with them, dealing bludgeoning damage.

name: Mind Sliver
description: You drive a disorienting spike of psychic energy into a creature's mind. On a failed Intelligence save it takes psychic damage and subtracts 1d4 from its next saving throw.

name: Mold Earth
description: You manipulate dirt or stone in a 5-foot cube, moving it, shaping it, or creating difficult terrain, or excavating a small amount.

name: Primal Savagery
description: Your teeth or nails sharpen with primal power. You make a melee spell attack that deals acid damage.

name: Shape Water
description: You reshape or animate a 5-foot cube of water, freeze it, change its color or opacity, or create simple shapes that last a short time.

name: Thorn Whip
components: V, S, M (the stem of a thorny plant)
description: You create a long, vine-like whip covered in thorns and make a melee spell attack. On a hit the target takes piercing damage and is pulled closer if it is Large or smaller.

name: Thunderclap
description: You create a burst of thunderous sound that can be heard from afar. Each creature in a 5-foot radius must succeed on a Constitution save or take thunder damage.

name: Toll the Dead
description: You point at a creature and a bell tolls. It takes necrotic damage; more if it is already missing hit points.

name: Vicious Mockery
description: You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments. The target must succeed on a Wisdom save or take psychic damage and have disadvantage on its next attack roll.

name: Word of Radiance
description: You utter a divine word and each creature of your choice within 5 feet must succeed on a Constitution save or take radiant damage.

name: Absorb Elements
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage
description: When you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, you capture some of the energy. You gain resistance to that damage type until your next turn and can add it to a melee attack.

name: Armor of Agathys
components: V, S, M (a shard of blue glass)
description: A protective magical frost covers you, granting temporary hit points. While those points remain, any creature that hits you with a melee attack takes cold damage.

name: Arms of Hadar
description: Tendrils of dark energy erupt from you and batter creatures within 10 feet. Each must succeed on a Strength save or take necrotic damage and can't take reactions until its next turn.

name: Beast Bond
components: V, S, M (a bit of fur wrapped in a cloth)
description: You forge a telepathic link with a willing beast. While linked you can communicate with it and it has advantage on attack rolls against creatures within 5 feet of you that you can see.

name: Catapult
description: You choose an object weighing 1 to 5 pounds and hurl it toward a target. On a hit it deals bludgeoning damage; the object can also be used to attack multiple times if it ricochets.

name: Cause Fear
range: . A construct or an undead is immune to this effect. The target
description: You awaken the sense of mortality in a creature. It must succeed on a Wisdom save or become frightened of you; it can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns.

name: Ceremony
components: V, S, M (25 gp worth of powdered silver, which the spell consumes)
description: You perform a special religious ceremony that can provide various benefits such as atonement, blessing a marriage, or dedicating a creature to a god, depending on the rite chosen.

name: Chromatic Orb
components: V, S, M (a diamond worth at least 50 gp)
description: You hurl a sphere of energy of a type you choose (acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder) at a creature. On a hit it takes damage of that type, and you can cause it to leap to additional targets.

name: Compelled Duel
description: You attempt to compel a creature into a duel. On a failed Wisdom save it has disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than you and must move toward you if it moves.

name: Dissonant Whispers
description: You whisper a discordant melody that only one creature can hear. On a failed Wisdom save it takes psychic damage and must use its reaction to move away from you.

name: Earth Tremor
description: You cause a tremor in the ground within range. Each creature in the area must succeed on a Dexterity save or take bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone; the ground becomes difficult terrain.

name: Ensnaring Strike
description: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before the spell ends, thorny vines wrap around it. It takes piercing damage and is restrained on a failed Strength save.

name: Hail of Thorns
casting_time: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Ranged weapon
description: The next time you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack, the projectile bursts into thorns. The target and nearby creatures take piercing damage on a failed Dexterity save.

name: Hunter's Mark
description: You mark a creature as your quarry. Until the spell ends you deal extra damage to it with weapon attacks and have advantage on checks to track it. You can move the mark if the target drops to 0 hit points.

name: Ice Knife
components: S, M (a drop of water or a piece of ice)
description: You create a shard of ice and fling it at a creature. On a hit it takes piercing damage, then the shard explodes dealing cold damage to the target and nearby creatures on a failed Dexterity save.

name: Ray of Sickness
description: A ray of sickening greenish energy streaks toward a creature. On a hit it takes poison damage and must succeed on a Constitution save or be poisoned until the end of your next turn.

name: Searing Smite
description: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, your weapon flares with white-hot intensity. The target takes fire damage and ignites, taking ongoing fire damage until it or a creature uses an action to douse the flames.

name: Silvery Barbs
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself succeeds on an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw
description: You magically distract a creature that succeeds on an attack, check, or save, forcing it to reroll and take the lower result. You can then give advantage to another creature's next roll.

name: Snare
components: S, M (25 feet of rope, which the spell consumes)
description: You create a magical trap using a rope. When a creature steps on the trapped area it must succeed on a Dexterity save or be magically hoisted into the air and restrained.

name: Spellfire Flare
description: You unleash a blast of brilliant spellfire that ignores cover. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit the target takes radiant damage. Higher-level slots create additional blasts.

name: Tasha's Caustic Brew
components: V, S, M (a bit of rotten food)
duration: or until a creature uses its action to scrape or wash the acid
description: A stream of acid gushes from you in a line. Each creature in the line must succeed on a Dexterity save or take acid damage at the start of each of its turns until it uses an action to scrape or wash the acid off.

name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
components: V, S, M (a tart and a feather)
description: A creature of your choice is overcome with laughter. On a failed Wisdom save it falls prone, becomes incapacitated, and can't stand up until the spell ends or it takes damage.

name: Tenser's Floating Disk
components: V, S, M (a drop of mercury)
description: You create a circular, horizontal plane of force that follows you and can carry up to 500 pounds of weight. It remains for the duration or until you dismiss it.

name: Thunderous Smite
casting_time: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: The next time you hit with a melee weapon attack, your weapon rings with thunder. The target takes extra thunder damage and must succeed on a Strength save or be pushed and knocked prone.

name: Wardaway
components: V, S, M (a miniature clay hand)
description: You gesture and a force of repulsion pushes a creature away from you. On a failed Strength save it is pushed up to 30 feet and takes force damage if it collides with an object or creature.

name: Witch Bolt
components: V, S, M (a twig struck by lightning)
description: A beam of crackling blue energy lances toward a creature. On a hit it takes lightning damage and you can use a bonus action on subsequent turns to deal additional lightning damage automatically while concentration lasts and the target remains in range.

name: Wrathful Smite
casting_time: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: The next time you hit with a melee weapon attack, your weapon carries spectral energy. The target takes psychic damage and must succeed on a Wisdom save or be frightened of you until the spell ends.

name: Zephyr Strike
description: You move like the wind. Until the spell ends your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks, you gain a bonus to speed, and once before it ends you can make one weapon attack with advantage that deals extra force damage.

name: Aganazzar's Scorcher
components: V, S, M (a red dragon's scale)
description: A line of roaring flame 30 feet long and 5 feet wide blasts from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must succeed on a Dexterity save or take fire damage.

name: Arcane Vigor
description: You tap into your life force to heal yourself. Roll one or two Hit Dice (your choice) and regain hit points equal to the total plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

name: Battle Familiar
components: V, S, M (a diamond worth 25+ GP)
description: You summon a special familiar that can fight alongside you. It has enhanced combat abilities compared to a standard familiar and remains for the duration.

name: Beast Sense
description: You touch a willing beast and gain the ability to see through its eyes and hear what it hears for the duration, while remaining aware of your own surroundings.

name: Cloud of Daggers
components: V, S, M (a sliver of glass)
description: You fill a 5-foot cube with spinning daggers. A creature that enters the area or starts its turn there takes slashing damage. You can move the cloud as a bonus action.

name: Cordon of Arrows
description: You plant four pieces of nonmagical ammunition in the ground. When a creature other than you comes within 30 feet of them, one flies up and attacks it. The ammunition is destroyed after attacking.

name: Crown of Madness
duration: . The creature succeeds automatically if it isn't Humanoid.
description: You force a humanoid to succumb to madness. On a failed Wisdom save a twisted crown appears on its head and it is charmed by you. You can force it to attack a creature of your choice on its turn.

name: Death Armor
components: V, S, M (an onyx worth 50+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: You touch a creature and surround it with a necrotic shield. It gains temporary hit points, and while they last any creature that hits it with a melee attack takes necrotic damage.

name: Deryan's Helpful Homunculi
components: V, S, M (powdered gemstones worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes, and one set of Artisan's Tools with which you have proficiency)
description: You create several tiny homunculi that perform simple tasks for you using the artisan's tools you provide. They last for the duration and can assist with crafting or other activities.

name: Disruptive Tune
description: You play a discordant melody that interferes with concentration. Creatures of your choice within range have disadvantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain concentration.

name: Dragon's Breath
description: You touch a willing creature and imbue it with the power to exhale elemental energy. As a bonus action the creature can breathe a 15-foot cone of acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison damage.

name: Dueling Ground
components: V, S, M (a silk flag worth 100+ GP)
description: You create a magical arena that forces two creatures into single combat. While inside, they cannot leave easily and outside creatures have difficulty interfering.

name: Earthbind
description: You attempt to bind a flying creature to the ground. On a failed Strength save its flying speed is reduced to 0 for the duration and it descends safely.

name: Elminster's Elusion
description: You become partially ethereal, gaining resistance to certain damage and the ability to move through objects or creatures with some risk of ending the effect early.

name: Healing Spirit
range: . The spirit looks like a transparent beast or fey (your choice).
description: You call forth a nature spirit that appears in a space you choose. As a bonus action you can move it and heal a creature in its space. The spirit vanishes after healing a number of times equal to 1 + your spellcasting modifier.

name: Homunculus Servant
components: V, S, M (a gem worth 100+ GP)
description: You create a tiny homunculus servant that follows your commands. It can deliver touch spells, perform simple tasks, and has a telepathic link with you.

name: Maximilian's Earthen Grasp
components: V, S, M (a miniature hand sculpted from clay)
description: You choose a 5-foot square of unoccupied earth and a Large hand of soil rises. It can grapple a creature, dealing bludgeoning damage, or be moved to attack others.

name: Melf's Ac1ip Arrow
description: A shimmering green arrow streaks toward a target and bursts in a spray of acid. On a hit the target takes acid damage immediately and again at the end of its next turn.

name: Melf's Acid Arrow
components: V, S, M (powdered rhubarb leaf and an adder's stomach)
description: A shimmering green arrow streaks toward a target and bursts in a spray of acid. On a hit the target takes acid damage immediately and again at the end of its next turn.

name: Mind Spike
description: You reach into the mind of a creature you can see. On a failed Wisdom save it takes psychic damage and you know its location until the spell ends, even if it becomes hidden or invisible.

name: Mooonbeam
components: V, S, M (several seeds of any moonseed plant and a piece of opalescent feldspar)
description: A silvery beam of pale light shines down in a 5-foot radius cylinder. Creatures that enter or start their turn in the light take radiant damage, and shapechangers have disadvantage on the save.

name: Nathair's Mischief
components: S, M (a piece of crust from an apple pie)
description: You fill a 20-foot cube with magical effects that randomly cause creatures to laugh uncontrollably, be outlined in faerie fire, or be affected by other mischievous illusions.

name: Nystul's Magic Aura
components: V, S, M (a small square of silk)
description: You place an illusion on a creature or object so that divination spells reveal false information about its magical properties or creature type.

name: Phantasmal Force
components: V, S, M (a bit of fleece)
description: You craft an illusion that takes root in the mind of a creature. On a failed Intelligence save it believes the illusion is real and can take psychic damage from it if the illusion is harmful.

name: Pyrotechnics
description: You cause an area of nonmagical flame to erupt in a dazzling display of fireworks or a thick cloud of smoke that heavily obscures the area.

name: Rime's Binding Ice
description: A cold wind freezes moisture into ice that covers creatures in a cone. On a failed Constitution save they take cold damage and their speed is reduced to 0 until they or another creature uses an action to break the ice.

name: Shadow Blade
description: You weave together threads of shadow to create a sword of solidified gloom in your hand. It deals psychic damage, has the finesse and light properties, and grants advantage in dim light or darkness.

name: Skywrite
description: You cause up to ten words to appear in a cloud formation in the sky. The words remain for the duration and can be seen from great distances.

name: Snilloc's Snowball Swarm
range: . Each creature in a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on that point
components: V, S, M (a piece of ice or a small white rock chip)
description: A flurry of magic snowballs erupts from a point you choose. Each creature in a 5-foot-radius sphere must succeed on a Dexterity save or take cold damage.

name: Summon Beast
components: V, S, M (a feather, tuft of fur, and fish tail inside a gilded acorn worth 200+ GP)
description: You call forth a bestial spirit that takes the form of a land, air, or water beast of your choice. It obeys your commands and acts on your turn.

name: Tasha's Mind Whip
description: You lash out at a creature's mind. On a failed Intelligence save it takes psychic damage and can't take a reaction until the end of its next turn; on its next turn it can take only an action or a bonus action, not both.

name: Uncertain Footing
description: You warp the perception of the ground in an area so that creatures treat it as difficult terrain and may fall prone if they move carelessly.

name: Warding Wind
description: A strong wind (20 miles per hour) blows around you in a 10-foot radius. It extinguishes unprotected flames, disperses gases, and imposes disadvantage on ranged weapon attacks that pass through it.

name: Warp Sense
description: You gain the ability to sense the presence of portals and planar rifts within range, and can attempt to identify their destinations.

name: Wither and Bloom
components: V, S, M (a withered vine twisted into a loop)
description: Necromantic energy washes over an area. Creatures of your choice take necrotic damage, while other creatures regain hit points. Plants in the area wither or bloom accordingly.

name: Ashardalon's Stride
description: The billowing flames of a dragon cover your feet, granting you a bonus to speed and allowing you to deal fire damage to creatures you move near without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Aura of Vitality
description: Healing energy radiates from you in a 30-foot aura. As a bonus action you can cause one creature in the aura to regain hit points.

name: Blinding Smite
casting_time: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: The next time you hit with a melee weapon attack, your weapon flares with bright light. The target takes radiant damage and must succeed on a Constitution save or be blinded until the spell ends.

name: Cacophonic Shield
description: You create a mobile shield of thunderous energy around yourself. It deals thunder damage to creatures that enter or start their turn in the area and grants you resistance to thunder damage.

name: Catnap
description: You make a calming gesture and up to three willing creatures fall unconscious for 10 minutes, gaining the benefits of a short rest if they remain undisturbed.

name: Conjure Barrage
components: V, S, M (a Melee or Ranged weapon worth at least 1 CP)
description: You brandish a weapon and conjure a spectral volley of identical projectiles that rain down in a 60-foot cone. Creatures in the area must succeed on a Dexterity save or take force damage.

name: Conjure Constructs
description: You summon constructs of metal and magic that fight for you. They obey your commands and last for the duration.

name: Crusader's Mantle
description: Holy power radiates from you in a 30-foot aura. Friendly creatures in the aura deal extra radiant damage with weapon attacks.

name: Elemental Weapon
description: A nonmagical weapon you touch becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls, and it deals extra damage of an elemental type you choose.

name: Enemies Abound
description: You reach into the mind of a creature and force it to perceive all other creatures as enemies. On a failed Intelligence save it must attack the nearest creature on its turns.

name: Erupting Earth
components: V, S, M (a piece of obsidian)
description: Choose a point on the ground. A fountain of churned earth and stone erupts in a 20-foot cube. Creatures in the area take bludgeoning damage on a failed Dexterity save and the ground becomes difficult terrain.

name: Feign Death
components: V, S, M (a pinch of graveyard dirt)
description: You touch a willing creature and put it into a cataleptic state that is indistinguishable from death. The target appears dead to all casual inspection and to spells used to determine its status.

name: Flame Arrows
description: You touch a quiver containing arrows or bolts. When a target is hit by a ranged weapon attack using one of those pieces of ammunition, the target takes extra fire damage. The magic ends on a piece of ammunition when it hits or misses.

name: Hunger of Hadar
description: You open a gateway to the dark between the stars, a region of cold and darkness that fills a 20-foot radius sphere. Creatures in the area take cold and acid damage and the area is heavily obscured.

name: Inflict Doubt
description: You sow seeds of uncertainty in a creature's mind. On a failed Wisdom save it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks for the duration.

name: Intellect Fortress
description: For the duration, you and any willing creatures you designate within range have resistance to psychic damage and advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

name: Laeral's Silver Lance
components: V, S, M (a silver pin worth 250+ GP)
description: You create a shimmering lance of silver force that you can hurl or wield. It deals force damage and can temporarily suppress a creature's ability to teleport or plane shift.

name: Leomund's Tiny Hut
components: V, S, M (a small crystal bead)
description: A 10-foot-radius immobile dome of force springs into existence around and above you. The spell fails if a Large or larger creature is inside. Creatures and objects within when you cast can move through freely, but others cannot.

name: Life Transference
description: You sacrifice some of your own health to mend another creature. You take necrotic damage, and the target regains hit points equal to twice the necrotic damage you take.

name: Lightning Arrow
casting_time: Bonus Action, which you can take immediately after hitting or missing a target with a ranged attack using a weapon
description: The next time you make a ranged weapon attack during the spell's duration, the weapon's ammunition transforms into a bolt of lightning. The attack deals lightning damage and the lightning leaps to additional targets.

name: Melf's Minute Meteors
components: V, S, M (niter, sulfur, and pine tar formed into a bead)
description: You create six tiny meteors in your space. As a bonus action you can send one or two streaking toward points you choose, where they explode in a 5-foot radius dealing fire and bludgeoning damage.

name: Spirit Shroud
duration: . The spirits are intangible and invulnerable. Until the spell
description: You call forth spirits of the dead that flit around you. Your attacks deal extra necrotic, radiant, or cold damage, and creatures of your choice within 10 feet have their speed reduced.

name: Summon Fey
components: V, S, M (a gilded flower worth 300+ GP)
description: You call forth a fey spirit that takes the form of a loyal companion. It has different options for its nature (fuming, mirthful, or tricksy) that grant different abilities.

name: Summon Lesser Demons
components: V, S, M (a vial of blood from a humanoid killed within the past 24 hours)
description: You summon one or more demons of challenge rating 1 or lower. They appear in unoccupied spaces and act according to their chaotic nature, though you can try to command them.

name: Summon Shadowspawn
components: V, S, M (tears inside a gem worth at least 300 gp)
description: You call forth a shadowy spirit that takes a form of your choosing (fury, despair, or fear). It obeys your commands and has abilities matching its chosen emotion.

name: Summon Undead
components: V, S, M (a gilded skull worth 300+ GP)
description: You call forth an undead spirit that takes the form of a ghostly or putrid undead of your choice. It obeys your verbal commands and acts on your turn.

name: Sylune's Viper
description: You create a spectral viper that coils around your arm or weapon. It can strike as part of your attacks, dealing poison damage and potentially poisoning the target.

name: Thunder Step
range: . Immediately after you disappear, a thunderous boom sounds,
description: You teleport yourself to an unoccupied space within range. A thunderous boom sounds, and each creature within 10 feet of the space you left must succeed on a Constitution save or take thunder damage.

name: Tidal Wave
range: . The area can be up to 30 feet long, up to 10 feet wide, and up
components: V, S, M (a drop of water)
description: You create a wall of water that crashes down on an area. Creatures in the area must succeed on a Dexterity save or take bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone; the water then spreads and extinguishes flames.

name: Tiny Servant
description: You touch an object that is not attached or carried and it animates as a tiny construct under your control. It can perform simple tasks and has limited combat ability.

name: Wall of Sand
components: V, S, M (a handful of sand)
description: You create a wall of swirling sand on the ground. It blocks line of sight, is difficult terrain, and can blind creatures that end their turn in it.

name: Wall of Water
range: . You can make the wall up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high, and 1
components: V, S, M (a drop of water)
description: You create a wall of water that can be shaped as a sheet or a ring. It heavily obscures the area, extinguishes fire, and deals cold damage to creatures that pass through it in certain conditions.

name: Aura of Life
description: Life-preserving energy radiates from you in a 30-foot aura. Nonhostile living creatures in the aura have resistance to necrotic damage and their hit point maximum can't be reduced; a creature at 0 hit points that starts its turn there gains 1 hit point.

name: Aura of Purity
description: Purifying energy radiates from you in a 30-foot aura. Nonhostile creatures in the aura can't become diseased, have resistance to poison damage, and have advantage on saving throws against effects that cause certain conditions.

name: Backlash
casting_time: Reaction, which you take in response to taking damage
description: When you take damage, you can use your reaction to force the attacker to take force damage equal to the damage you just took (up to a limit).

name: Charm Monster
description: You attempt to charm a creature you can see. On a failed Wisdom save it is charmed by you until the spell ends or you or your companions do anything harmful to it.

name: Distorted Distance
description: You warp space in an area so that distances appear greater or shorter than they are, affecting movement and ranged attacks in complex ways.

name: Doomtide
components: V, S, M (soot and a dried eel)
description: You summon a wave of necrotic energy and shadow that washes over an area, dealing necrotic damage and possibly imposing the frightened or other conditions.

name: Elemental Bane
description: Choose a creature and an elemental damage type. The target loses resistance to that type and takes extra damage of that type whenever it takes such damage.

name: Evard's Black Tentacles
description: Squirming, ebony tentacles fill a 20-foot square. Creatures in the area must succeed on a Dexterity save or take bludgeoning damage and be restrained; restrained creatures take damage at the start of their turns.

name: Festering Blast
description: You create a blast of necrotic energy that causes wounds to fester. Creatures in the area take necrotic damage and may have their healing reduced for a time.

name: Find Greater Steed
description: You summon a loyal steed of a more powerful type than the standard Find Steed, such as a griffon or pegasus. It serves you as a mount and companion.

name: Fount of Moonlight
description: You become infused with moonlight, shedding bright light and gaining the ability to deal radiant damage with your attacks or to blind creatures that attack you.

name: Gate Seal
components: V, S, M (a broken portal key, which the spell consumes)
description: You permanently seal a planar gate or portal within range, preventing it from being opened by normal means for the duration (or permanently if cast with a higher slot or special components).

name: Grasping Vine
description: You cause a vine to sprout from a point within range. You can use a bonus action to direct the vine to grapple a creature or pull it toward the vine's location.

name: Guardian of Nature
description: You transform into a powerful guardian form, either a primal beast or a great tree, gaining enhanced senses, attacks, or defensive abilities for the duration.

name: Leomund's Secret Chest
components: for the spell. The chest can contain up to 12 cubic feet of nonliving material (3 feet by 2 feet by 2 feet).
description: You hide a chest and its contents on the Ethereal Plane. You can use an action to recall the chest, and it remains safe until you do so or the spell ends.

name: Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound
description: You conjure a phantom watchdog that remains in a 30-foot radius. It becomes visible and attacks any creature that comes within 30 feet of it that is hostile to you, dealing force damage and never being surprised.

name: Mordenkainen's Private Sanctum
components: V, S, M (a thin sheet of lead)
description: You make an area magically secure against scrying, teleportation, planar travel, and sound transmission, with options to customize the protections.

name: Otiluke's Resilient Sphere
description: A sphere of shimmering force encloses a creature or object of Large size or smaller. The sphere is weightless and immune to damage; nothing can pass through it, though the enclosed creature can breathe.

name: Raulothim's Psychic Lance
description: You unleash a shimmering lance of psychic energy at a creature you can see or name. On a failed Intelligence save it takes psychic damage and is incapacitated until the start of your next turn.

name: Shadow of Moil
components: V, S, M (an undead eyeball encased in a gem worth at least 150 gp)
description: Flame-like shadows wreathe your body, turning bright light into dim light and granting you resistance to radiant damage. While the shadows last, creatures that hit you with melee attacks take necrotic damage.

name: Sickening Radiance
description: You create a 30-foot-radius sphere of greenish light. Creatures that start their turn in the light take radiant damage and gain a level of exhaustion on a failed Constitution save; the light also suppresses magical darkness.

name: Spellfire Storm
description: You call down a storm of spellfire in an area that deals radiant damage to creatures and can destroy magical effects or force concentration checks.

name: Staggering Smite
casting_time: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: The next time you hit with a melee weapon attack, your weapon strikes with psychic force. The target takes psychic damage and must succeed on a Wisdom save or have disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks and be unable to take reactions until the end of its next turn.

name: Storm Sphere
description: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of whirling air. As a bonus action you can cause a bolt of lightning to leap from the sphere toward a creature, dealing lightning damage on a failed Dexterity save. The sphere also makes ranged attacks difficult.

name: Summon Aberration
components: V, S, M (a pickled tentacle and an eyeball ina platinum-inlaid vial worth 400+ GP)
description: You call forth an aberrant spirit that takes the form of a beholder-like or tentacled creature of your choice. It obeys your commands and has unique abilities based on its form.

name: Summon Construct
components: V, S, M (a lockbox worth 400+ GP)
description: You summon a construct spirit that takes a metal or stone form. It follows your verbal commands and can be customized with different defensive or offensive traits.

name: Summon Elemental
components: V, S, M (air, a pebble, ash, and water inside a gold- inlaid vial worth 400+ GP)
description: You call forth an elemental spirit that takes the form of an air, earth, fire, or water elemental of your choice. It obeys your commands and acts on your initiative.

name: Summon Greater Demon
components: V, S, M (a vial of blood from a humanoid killed within the past 24 hours)
description: You summon a demon of challenge rating 5 or lower. It appears and acts according to its nature; you can attempt to control it with Charisma checks, but it may turn on you if not carefully managed.

name: Vitriolic Sphere
components: V, S, M (a drop of giant slug bile)
description: You point at a location and a 1-foot-diameter glowing green orb of acid streaks there and explodes. Creatures in a 20-foot radius take acid damage on a failed Dexterity save, and residual acid continues to burn on a failed save.

name: Watery Sphere
components: V, S, M (a droplet of water)
description: You create a sphere of water that can restrain creatures inside it. You can move the sphere and force it to dash, potentially carrying restrained creatures with it or slamming them into surfaces.

name: Zone of Amicability
description: You create an area where creatures find it difficult to act hostile. Creatures in the zone have disadvantage on attack rolls against other creatures in the zone and may be compelled to stop fighting.

name: Alustriel's Mooncloak
components: V, S, M (a moonstone worth 50+ GP)
description: You wrap yourself in a cloak of moonlight that grants you resistance to certain damage types, the ability to hover, and protection from some divination effects.

name: Banishing Smite
casting_time: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: The next time you hit with a melee weapon attack, your weapon crackles with force. The target takes force damage, and if this reduces it to 50 hit points or fewer it is banished to a harmless demiplane until the spell ends.

name: Circle of Power
description: Divine energy radiates from you in a 30-foot aura. Creatures of your choice in the aura have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and resistance to damage from such effects if they succeed.

name: Conjure Volley
components: V, S, M (a Melee or Ranged weapon worth at least 1 CP)
description: You brandish a weapon and fire a piece of ammunition that multiplies into a volley. Creatures in a 40-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder must succeed on a Dexterity save or take force damage.

name: Control Winds
range: . Choose one of the following effects when you cast the spell.
description: You take control of the air in a 100-foot cube, choosing one of several effects: gusts that push creatures, a downdraft that forces flying creatures to the ground, or an updraft that lifts creatures upward.

name: Danse Macabre
description: Threads of dark power leap from your fingers to pierce up to five Small or Medium corpses. Each becomes an undead skeleton or zombie under your control for the duration.

name: Dawn
components: V, S, M (a sunburst pendant worth at least 100 gp)
description: A cylinder of bright sunlight fills an area. Creatures that start their turn in the light or enter it take radiant damage on a failed Constitution save, and the light suppresses magical darkness and affects undead and oozes particularly.

name: Destructive Wave
description: You strike the ground and send a wave of divine energy outward. Creatures of your choice within 30 feet must succeed on a Constitution save or take thunder or radiant damage and be knocked prone.

name: Dispel Evil and Goopd
components: V, S, M (powdered silver and iron)
description: You can end certain magical effects or conditions caused by celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead, or use a melee attack to deal damage and potentially banish such a creature.

name: Enervation
description: A tendril of inky darkness reaches out and touches a creature. On a failed Dexterity save it takes necrotic damage and you can use a bonus action on subsequent turns to deal additional necrotic damage automatically while concentration lasts.

name: Far Step
description: You teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. On each of your turns before the spell ends you can use a bonus action to teleport in this way again.

name: Grave Ground
components: V, S, M (a handful of grave dirt)
description: You transform an area of ground into a grave-like terrain that deals necrotic damage to creatures that start their turn there and may hinder movement or impose conditions related to death and decay.

name: Holy Weapon
description: You imbue a weapon you touch with holy power. It sheds bright light, deals extra radiant damage on hits, and can burst with radiant energy that blinds nearby enemies when the spell ends.

name: Immolation
description: Flames wreathe a creature you can see. On a failed Dexterity save it takes fire damage and is set ablaze, taking ongoing fire damage at the start of its turns until it or another creature extinguishes the flames.

name: Infernal Calling
components: V, S, M (a ruby worth at least 999 gp)
description: You call forth a devil of challenge rating 6 or lower. It appears and may negotiate service; you must offer a suitable payment or risk it acting against your interests.

name: Jallarzi's Storm of Radiance
range: . While in this area, creatures have the Blinded and Deafened
components: V, S, M (a pinch of phosphorus)
description: You create a storm of radiant energy in a cylinder that deals radiant damage to creatures inside and can impose the blinded condition.

name: Maelstrom
components: V, S, M (paper or leaf in the shape of a funnel)
description: A swirling mass of water appears in a 30-foot radius. Creatures in the area must succeed on a Strength save or take bludgeoning damage and be pulled toward the center; the area is difficult terrain.

name: Masss Cure Wounds
range: . Choose up to six creatures in a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered
description: A wave of healing energy washes out from a point you choose. Up to six creatures of your choice regain hit points.

name: Mordenkainen's Lucubration
description: You recall a spell of 5th level or lower that you have previously prepared and already cast today, restoring it to your mind so you can cast it again.

name: Negative Energy Flood
components: V, M (a broken bone and a square of black silk)
description: You send ribbons of negative energy at a creature. On a hit it takes necrotic damage; if this reduces it to 0 hit points it rises as a zombie under your control (if it was a humanoid).

name: Rarry'ss Telepathic Bond
description: You forge a telepathic link among up to eight willing creatures of your choice within range. Until the spell ends the targets can communicate telepathically through the bond whether or not they share a language.

name: Rary's Telepathic Bond
components: V, S, M (pieces of eggshell from two different kinds of creatures)
description: You forge a telepathic link among up to eight willing creatures of your choice within range. Until the spell ends the targets can communicate telepathically through the bond whether or not they share a language.

name: Skill Empowerment
description: Your magic deepens a creature's understanding of its own talent. It gains expertise (double proficiency bonus) in one skill of your choice for the duration.

name: Songal's Elemental Suffusion
components: V, S, M (a pearl worth 100+ GP)
description: You imbue a creature with elemental power of a type you choose, granting it resistance or immunity to that damage type and the ability to deal extra elemental damage with its attacks.

name: Spirit Lantern
description: You create a lantern of spiritual light that can reveal invisible creatures, deal radiant damage to undead, or provide guidance and protection to allies.

name: Steel Wind Strike
components: S, M (a Melee weapon worth 1+ SP)
description: You flourish a weapon and vanish, teleporting to strike up to five creatures you can see within range with a single fluid motion. Make a melee spell attack against each; on a hit the target takes force damage.

name: Summon Celestial
components: V, S, M (a reliquary worth 500+ GP)
description: You call forth a celestial spirit that takes the form of an avenger or defender. It obeys your commands and has healing or radiant abilities based on its form.

name: Summon Draconic Spirit
components: V, S, M (an object with the image of a dragon engraved on it, worth at least 500 gp)
description: You summon a draconic spirit that takes the form of a chromatic, gem, or metallic dragon of your choice. It has a breath weapon and other traits matching its type.

name: Summon Plant
description: You call forth a plant spirit that takes the form of a dryad-like or treant-like creature. It obeys your commands and can manipulate plant life in the area.

name: Swift Quiver
components: V, S, M (a Quiver worth 1+ GP)
description: You transmute your quiver so that it produces an endless supply of nonmagical ammunition. You can make two attacks with a weapon that uses ammunition as a bonus action on each of your turns.

name: Synaptic Static
description: You choose a point and cause psychic energy to explode there. Creatures in a 20-foot radius must succeed on an Intelligence save or take psychic damage and have their attack rolls, ability checks, and concentration saves penalized for a short time.

name: Transmute Rock
description: You choose an area of stone or mud and transmute it into the other substance. Stone becomes mud (difficult terrain that can restrain) or mud becomes stone (trapping creatures that fail a Dexterity save).

name: Wall of Light
description: You create a wall of brilliant light that can be shaped as a line or a ring. Creatures that pass through or start their turn in the wall take radiant damage and may be blinded; the wall also sheds bright light.

name: Waves of Exhaustion
components: V, S, M (a piece of dried meat)
description: You emit waves of necrotic energy that drain the vitality of creatures in a cone. On a failed Constitution save they gain levels of exhaustion.

name: Wrath of Nature
description: You call on the spirits of nature to animate trees, vines, rocks, and weather in an area, creating multiple hazards that attack or hinder your enemies each turn.

name: Yolande's Regal Presence
description: You surround yourself with an aura of fey majesty. Creatures of your choice that start their turn in the aura must succeed on a Wisdom save or become charmed or frightened, and you gain benefits to Charisma-based interactions.

name: Arcane Gate
description: You create linked teleportation portals that remain open for the duration. Creatures can step through one to exit the other, and you can rotate the portals as a bonus action.

name: Bones of the Earth
description: You cause up to six pillars of stone to burst from places on the ground that you can see. Each pillar is a cylinder that can lift creatures or crush them against ceilings if they fail a Dexterity save.

name: Create Homunculus
components: V, S, M (clay, ash, and mandrake root, all of which the spell consumes, and a jewel-encrusted dagger worth at least 1,000 gp)
description: You create a homunculus by performing a special ritual with rare materials. The homunculus is permanently bound to you and serves as a loyal companion.

name: Dirge
description: You play or sing a mournful dirge that fills an area with despair. Creatures that hear it must succeed on a Wisdom save or be frightened or have their morale broken, taking psychic damage over time.

name: Drawmij's Instant Summons
components: V, S, M (a sapphire worth 1,000+ GP)
description: You touch an object and write a special mark on it. Later you can use an action to speak the object's name and instantly transport it to your hand, regardless of distance (with some limitations if another creature holds it).

name: Druid Grove
components: V, S, M (mistletoe, which the spell consumes, that was harvested with a golden sickle under the light of a full moon)
description: You create a protected grove that lasts for an extended period. It provides benefits such as enhanced healing, alarm effects, and the ability to support additional plant or animal allies.

name: Elminster's Effulgent Spheres
components: V, S, M (an opal worth 1,000 GP+)
description: You create several glowing spheres of force that orbit you. You can use a bonus action to send one streaking toward a target, dealing force damage and possibly imposing conditions.

name: Fizban's Platinum Shield
components: V, S, M (a platinum-plated dragon scale, worth at least 500 gp)
description: You create a protective field of silvery force around a creature. It gains resistance to certain damage types, half cover, and immunity to the frightened condition while the shield lasts.

name: Heroes' Feast
components: V, S, M (a gem-encrusted bowl worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: You bring forth a great feast that takes one hour to consume. Creatures that partake gain temporary hit points, immunity to poison and being frightened, and advantage on Wisdom saves for 24 hours.

name: Investiture of Flame
description: Flames race across your body, shedding bright light and granting immunity to fire damage. You can use an action to create a line of fire or cause fire damage to creatures that touch or hit you.

name: Investiture of Ice
description: Ice rimes your body, granting immunity to cold damage and the ability to create a cone of cold or make the ground icy around you.

name: Investiture of Stone
description: You gain a rocky hide that grants resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and you can cause the earth to tremble or move through stone.

name: Investiture of Wind
description: Winds whirl around you, granting a flying speed and the ability to push creatures or create a blast of wind that disperses gases and extinguishes flames.

name: Mental Prison
description: You attempt to bind a creature within an illusory cell that only it can perceive. On a failed Intelligence save it is trapped, taking psychic damage if it attempts to leave or if the illusion is interacted with in certain ways.

name: Moove Earth
range: . You can reshape dirt, sand, or clay in the area in any manner
description: You choose an area of terrain made of dirt, sand, or clay and reshape it in real time. You can raise or lower the elevation, create trenches, or form walls, but cannot affect stone.

name: Otiluke's Freezing Sphere
components: V, S, M (a small crystal sphere)
description: A frigid globe of cold energy streaks from your fingertips to a point of your choice, where it explodes in a 60-foot-radius sphere. Creatures in the area take cold damage on a failed Constitution save; the globe can also be thrown or used to freeze water.

name: Otto's Irresistible Dance
description: You cause a creature to begin a comic dance. On a failed Wisdom save it must use all its movement to dance in place, has disadvantage on Dexterity saves and attack rolls, and other creatures have advantage on attacks against it.

name: Otto'ss Irresistible Dance
description: You cause a creature to begin a comic dance. On a failed Wisdom save it must use all its movement to dance in place, has disadvantage on Dexterity saves and attack rolls, and other creatures have advantage on attacks against it.

name: Primordial Ward
description: You gain resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder damage for the duration. As a reaction when you take damage of one of those types you can become immune to that type instead until the start of your next turn.

name: Scatter
description: You teleport up to five willing creatures you can see within range to new locations within a limited distance that you can also see, rearranging their positions instantly.

name: Soul Cage
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a humanoid you can see within 60 feet of you dies
components: V, S, M (a tiny silver cage worth 100 gp)
description: You snatch the soul of a humanoid that dies within range and trap it in a tiny cage. While trapped you can use the soul to ask questions, view its memories, or exploit it for other benefits a limited number of times.

name: Summon Dinosaur
components: V, S, M (polished scale worth 600+ GP)
description: You call forth the spirit of a dinosaur that takes a form of your choosing (such as a predator or herbivore of appropriate size). It obeys your commands and has traits matching its species.

name: Summon Fiend
components: V, S, M (a bloody vial worth 600+ GP)
description: You summon a fiendish spirit that takes the form of a demon, devil, or yugoloth of your choice. It obeys your commands but may have its own agenda if not carefully controlled.

name: Tasha's Bubbling Cauldron
components: V, S, M (a gilded ladle worth 500+ GP)
description: You create a magical cauldron that produces a number of potions of your choice (from a limited list) over the course of an hour. The potions last for 24 hours or until consumed.

name: Tasha's Otherworldly Guise
components: V, S, M (an object engraved with a symbol of the Outer Planes, worth at least 500 gp)
description: You transform your body to better match a creature of the Outer Planes. You gain temporary hit points, resistance to certain damage, a flying or swimming speed, and the ability to deal extra force or necrotic damage.

name: Tenser's Transformation
components: V, S, M (a few hairs from a bull)
description: You endow yourself with endurance and martial prowess. You gain temporary hit points, proficiency with martial weapons and armor, extra attacks, and other combat benefits, but cannot cast spells while transformed.

name: Aura of Evasion
description: You and friendly creatures within 30 feet of you gain the benefits of the Evasion feature, taking no damage on successful Dexterity saves against effects that normally deal half damage on a success.

name: Crown of Stars
description: Seven star-like motes of light appear and orbit your head. You can use a bonus action to send one mote streaking toward a creature, making a ranged spell attack that deals radiant damage.

name: Draconic Transformation
components: V, S, M (a statuette of a dragon, worth at least 500 gp)
description: You channel draconic power, growing spectral wings, gaining a breath weapon, blindsight, and other dragon-like traits for the duration.

name: Dream of the Blue Veil
components: V, S, M (a magic item or a willing creature from the destination world)
description: You and up to eight willing creatures project your minds into a shared dream that allows travel to another world or plane connected by the blue veil, with risks if the dream is disrupted.

name: Fractured Awareness
description: You shatter a creature's perception of reality. On a failed Intelligence save it is overwhelmed by conflicting sensory input, taking psychic damage and suffering disadvantage on attacks and checks.

name: Mansion
components: V, S, M (a miniature door worth 15+ GP)
description: You conjure an extradimensional dwelling that has multiple rooms, is furnished and staffed by unseen servants, and remains for the duration. Only creatures you designate can enter.

name: Mordenkainen's Sword
components: V, S, M (a miniature sword worth 250+ GP)
description: You create a sword-shaped plane of force that floats and attacks creatures of your choice within range, dealing force damage on a hit. You can move it as a bonus action.

name: Power Word Fortify
description: You speak a word of power that bolsters the defenses of up to six creatures you can see. They gain temporary hit points and possibly other defensive benefits.

name: Power Word Pain
description: You speak a word of power that causes a creature with 100 hit points or fewer to be wracked with pain. It has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws, and its speed is reduced, until it receives magical healing.

name: Reweave Fate
casting_time: Reaction, which you take when a creature you can see within 60 feet of you fails a D20 Test
description: You briefly alter the threads of fate for a creature, allowing it to reroll a failed saving throw or attack roll, or granting it a temporary boon or protection against a specific threat.

name: Simbul's Synostodweomer
description: You convert a spell slot into healing energy. As an action you can touch a creature and restore hit points based on the level of the slot expended, or use it to cure certain conditions.

name: Temple of the Gods
components: V, S, M (a holy symbol worth at least 5 gp)
description: You create a temple that is protected against certain creature types and provides benefits to worshippers of your deity, including enhanced healing and warding effects that last for an extended period.

name: Transfix
description: You attempt to transform a creature into a different form. On a failed Constitution save its body and mind are changed, potentially granting it a new creature type, abilities, or appearance for the duration.

name: Abi-Dalzim's Horrid Wilting
components: V, S, M (a bit of sponge)
description: You draw moisture from every creature in a 30-foot cube. Each creature must succeed on a Constitution save or take necrotic damage; plants and water elementals have disadvantage on the save and take maximum damage.

name: Entrancing Mirrors
description: You create a set of magical mirrors that can capture the attention of creatures, charm them, or reflect spells and attacks back at their originators.

name: Holy Star of Mystra
description: You create a brilliant star of magical force that orbits you. It can absorb incoming spells of a certain level, store them, and later release them or convert the energy into healing or force damage.

name: Illusory Dragon
description: You create a Huge illusory dragon that appears real. Creatures that fail an Intelligence save believe it is a true dragon and can take psychic damage from its illusory breath weapon; the illusion can move and act convincingly.

name: Lightning Ring
components: V, S, M (a bit of fur and a glass ring)
description: You create a ring of lightning around yourself or a point. Creatures that enter or start their turn in the ring take lightning damage, and you can expand or contract the ring as a bonus action.

name: Maddening Darkness
components: V, M (a drop of pitch mixed with a drop of mercury)
description: Magical darkness spreads from a point you choose, filling a 60-foot-radius sphere. Creatures in the darkness take psychic damage at the start of their turns on a failed Wisdom save, and the darkness can't be illuminated by nonmagical means.

name: Mighty Fortress
components: V, S, M (a diamond worth at least 500 gp, which the spell consumes)
description: You conjure a fortress of stone that fills a square area. It has multiple floors, defensive features, and remains for seven days or until you dismiss it. Creatures inside are protected from weather and some magical detection.

name: Moment of Prescience
casting_time: Reaction, which you take when you fail a D20 Test or when a creature hits you with an attack roll
description: You gain a powerful insight into the immediate future. Once during the duration you can choose to replace one attack roll, saving throw, or ability check you make with a natural 20, or impose a natural 1 on an attack against you.

name: Telepathy
components: V, S, M (a pair of linked silver rings)
description: You create a telepathic link between yourself and a willing creature. You can communicate telepathically across any distance as long as you are on the same plane, and the link lasts until you dismiss it or one of you dies.

name: Tsunami
range: . You can make the wall up to 300 feet long, 300 feet high, and
description: A wall of water 300 feet long, 300 feet high, and 50 feet thick appears and surges forward. Creatures caught in it must succeed on a Strength save or take bludgeoning damage and be swept away; the water continues moving for several turns.

name: Blade of Disaster
description: You create a blade-shaped planar rift that behaves like a weapon. You can make melee spell attacks with it that deal force damage, and on a critical hit it deals extra damage and can create a temporary rift that damages nearby creatures.

name: Detonate
components: V, S, M (a piece of tinder)
description: You cause a creature or object that is concentrating on a spell or that contains explosive material to explode. The target takes force damage and the explosion affects nearby creatures.

name: Hindsight
components: V, S, M (a tiny hourglass worth 500+ GP, which the spell consumes)
description: You touch a creature or object and gain a vision of significant events that occurred to it in the past, up to a number of days equal to your level or more with higher slots.

name: Invulnerability
components: V, S, M (a piece of adamantine worth 500+, GP, which the spell consumes)
description: You gain immunity to all damage for the duration. The spell ends early if you attack or cast a spell.

name: Mass Polymorph
description: You transform up to ten creatures of your choice within range into new forms of challenge rating equal to or less than their own. Unwilling creatures must succeed on a Wisdom save to resist.

name: Power Word Heal
description: A wave of healing energy washes over a creature you can see. It regains all its hit points and is cured of certain conditions such as charmed, frightened, paralyzed, or stunned.

name: Psychic Scream
description: You unleash the power of your mind to blast the intellect of up to ten creatures of your choice that you can see. On a failed Intelligence save a target takes psychic damage and is stunned.

name: Vision of Elapsing Eons
description: You create an illusory vision of the passage of vast time in an area. Creatures that fail a Wisdom save are overwhelmed by the sensation of ages passing, taking psychic damage and possibly aging or becoming incapacitated temporarily.

name: Wail of the Banshee
description: You emit a mournful wail. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet that can hear you must succeed on a Constitution save or drop to 0 hit points; on a success it takes psychic damage instead.
